cross_script_comparison.note: same HINDI domain, different script/transliteration -- not a true parallel pair, just the closest available cross-script comparison in the pilot sample

unrelated_domain_check.expectation: should be clearly lower than same-domain/same-topic pairs

caveat: This is a technical/basic sanity check (dimensions, finiteness, normalization, rough nearest-neighbour plausibility) -- it is NOT proof of embedding quality, and especially not proof of equal quality across Devanagari vs Romanized-Hindi vs English input, per the task's explicit caution against assuming that. If similarity_compression_observed is true, the 'unrelated' cross-domain pair scored close to or above the median pairwise similarity in the pilot -- a sign of the anisotropy commonly seen in sentence-embedding models, where even unrelated texts score high raw cosine similarity. The next milestone should treat raw cosine similarity as a RELATIVE ranking signal (nearest-neighbour ordering), not an absolute relatedness threshold, unless/until this is calibrated further.
